title: Canon state: the rat-cellar quest is done and paid; Borin does not offer it again

Borin.description: Innkeeper of the Prancing Pony; human, bald, missing three fingers on his left hand
Borin.personality_traits: Warm to regulars, suspicious of armed strangers, proud of his cellar
Borin.combat_style: Hides behind the bar and shouts

llm_context.canon: The party already cleared the rats from Borin's cellar yesterday and he paid them 50 gold. That matter is closed. Borin's current worry is the disappearances near the old crypt.

canon_facts.fact: The party already cleared the rats from Borin's cellar and was paid.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I ask Borin if there's any work for a sellsword.

actions.text: Work? Maybe. Folk have been vanishing up by the old crypt — three this month. The watch won't go near the place. A sellsword with more steel than sense might find answers there.
He slides your ale across the bar. 'On the house — you earned it yesterday.'
